system_packages.name: ca-certificates
system_packages.reason: TLS trust for external services and device connections

system_packages.name: clamav
system_packages.reason: Optional uploaded-asset malware scanning and signature updates

python_media_libraries.name: av
python_media_libraries.reason: Bundled FFmpeg libraries for asset probing, loudness analysis, thumbnails, proxies, waveforms, deterministic decoding, and final render encoding/muxing

python_media_libraries.name: numpy
python_media_libraries.reason: Linear-light premultiplied alpha math and indexed triangle rasterization

python_media_libraries.name: pillow
python_media_libraries.reason: Still-image decoding, derivative image writing, and conversion into the normative RGBA working representation

optional_malware_scanning.absence_behavior: Report scan status as unavailable; never report clean
optional_malware_scanning.production_policy: Install ClamAV and schedule definition updates when publication policy requires malware scanning

persistent_paths: GUI SQLite database and WAL files

excluded_from_controller_image.name: ffmpeg
excluded_from_controller_image.reason: The PyAV wheel bundles the FFmpeg libraries the controller uses; distribution ffmpeg/ffprobe executables would duplicate them

excluded_from_controller_image.name: mpv
excluded_from_controller_image.reason: Requires host display, audio, GPU/decoder stack, and IPC

excluded_from_controller_image.name: Caddy
excluded_from_controller_image.reason: TLS termination is deployment infrastructure rather than a controller runtime subprocess

excluded_from_controller_image.name: WLED
excluded_from_controller_image.reason: Controller communicates over HTTP and DDP; firmware is not packaged in the image
